item.description:
Hard to believe that we’re now approaching the seventh year since Madonna’s last studio album, Madame X, was released, marking the longest gap between two Madonna albums in her entire career. But that doesn’t mean she’s been totally absent from the music scene : In the time since, Madonna has lent her voice to a variety of official collaborations, remixes, and featurings, keeping her name on records and promos in more or less exciting ways. This collection brings together every official studio track featuring Madonna released between Madame X and the upcoming and highly anticipated 'Confessions Part 2'. Each track is presented in the best quality available, many in pristine HD 24-bit audio, all in lossless format.
